_comment: PLACEHOLDER rules (Spike B 3c) that derive each tile's land state for any year from its present-day (2026) state. They are NOT history: real historic land use needs hand-traced Sanborn/archival maps (§30.5 step 3). Every number here is a guess chosen to look plausible, flagged for replacement.

town_origin._comment: Uptown: intersection of High Street and Main Street from OSM (lat 39.51049, lon -84.74242). The Mile Square town was laid out in 1810 (walking tour).

clearing._comment: Present-day open land starts as forest and is cleared outward from Uptown: pasture first, farmland farmland_delay_years later.

university._comment: University land develops outward from each dated campus building (built_year + distance / spread). Tiles far from any dated building become university land at max_year at the latest.

roads._comment: Roads/paths appear once their tile is developed (or, in the countryside, once cleared). Railway tiles appear at railway_year. Road surface colour follows eras.json road_type.
